title: A Parish for the Cipher
author: E. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Freya Kavanagh, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
